normalized.result: Yes, that balance feels right. On the library card the long title, description, and note are trimmed with an ellipsis so the card stays tidy and scannable, and the tags wrap neatly onto their own row. Then when I open "Edit bookmark," every word is there in full and editable — nothing was actually lost, just shortened for display. That's exactly how I'd want it: a clean overview that doesn't sacrifice any of my content. This works well for me.
